description: This source file implements API routes for managing user files in a FastAPI application. Features include listing files, uploading new files with validation and storage, and deleting files. It interacts with a Supabase backend for storage and metadata management, and handles user session-based file organization.

methods.name: Client get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase client initialized with environment variables.

methods.name: str _ext(name: str)
methods.description: Extracts the file extension from a filename, lowercased.

methods.name: list_files(session_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter files by session ID"), user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Lists files for the current user, optionally filtered by session ID.

methods.name: upload_file( session_id: str = Form(..., description="Target session ID"), upload: UploadFile = File(..., description="File to upload (.docx, .pdf, .txt, .xlsx)"), user=Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles uploading a file, validating type and size, storing in Supabase Storage, and recording metadata.

methods.name: delete_file(file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a file's storage object and metadata if owned by the current user.

methods.name: delete_session_file(session_id: str, file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a file associated with a specific session, verifying ownership and session association.
